document_title: Haryana Resale Agreement Compliance Rules — Gurugram

rules.name: Parties and property identification
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement clearly identifies the seller, buyer, property, project, unit number, location and relevant developer or builder references, and that these details are internally consistent throughout the agreement.

rules.name: Seller title and right to transfer
rules.rule: Verify that the seller represents having valid title, ownership rights and legal authority to sell and transfer the property, and that the underlying allotment or builder-buyer documentation supporting the seller's ownership is identified or available.
required_evidence: Evidence of seller's ownership or allotment
Transfer or assignment documents where applicable

rules.name: No undisclosed encumbrance
rules.rule: Verify that the seller has represented that the property is free from charges, liens, mortgages, home loans, encumbrances, court proceedings and third-party claims, and that appropriate clearance or no-encumbrance documentation is required before transfer where applicable.

rules.name: Total sale consideration
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement clearly states the total sale consideration and that the consideration is consistent across the agreement, payment clauses and payment schedule, including agreed charges, taxes, parking or other included components.

rules.name: Advance payment and agreement threshold
rules.rule: Verify the amount already paid before execution of the agreement and compare it with the stated total sale consideration. Where the Haryana RERA 10% threshold is relevant to the transaction, verify whether the agreement and payment sequence are consistent with the applicable requirement.

rules.name: Payment schedule and reconciliation
rules.rule: Verify that the payment schedule specifies payment dates, amounts, beneficiaries and payment descriptions, and that the scheduled payments reconcile to the stated total sale consideration after accounting for TDS or other stated deductions. Identify any arithmetic mismatch or unexplained amount.

rules.name: Transfer and registration obligations
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement clearly specifies the obligations and timeline for completing the transaction, executing the sale deed and registering the property, and identifies which party is responsible for the required registration and transfer formalities.

rules.name: Refund and indemnity protection
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement provides a contractual remedy if the seller or developer fails to transfer the property, including refund of amounts received and, where stated, indemnification for losses arising from incorrect title, encumbrance or ownership representations.

rules.name: Dues, taxes and transaction expenses
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement clearly allocates outstanding property dues, taxes, fees, stamp duties, registration charges, processing fees and other transaction expenses between the parties and specifies the applicable point in time for each obligation.

rules.name: Transfer documentation and clearance
rules.rule: Verify that the seller is responsible for arranging the documentation, approvals, loan clearance, no-encumbrance evidence and other formalities required for transfer of the property to the buyer, and identify any required documents that are referenced but not provided.

rules.name: Real estate intermediary and consultation charges
rules.rule: Where an intermediary or real estate advisor is involved, verify that the agreement identifies the intermediary, the applicable fee or commission, the basis of calculation, applicable GST or taxes, and any stated registration or license reference. Where only a synthetic or non-verifiable registration reference is provided, escalate for human verification.
